data.reasoning: The disagreement is entirely due to a tool error in the first report. The qwen model failed with an HTTP 400 error while reviewing the PKGBUILD, rendering its inconclusive verdict invalid. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files, including the PKGBUILD, and correctly identified standard, non-malicious AUR packaging practices.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an API failure (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) during the full repository review of the PKGBUILD, forcing an inconclusive result. The deepseek model completed the review without errors and found the PKGBUILD to be safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400)
learnings: Implement retry logic or graceful fallbacks for LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) during file reviews to prevent a single transient failure from invalidating an otherwise complete audit.
